# SOTANAKA

> SOTANAKA is a Tokyo-based design studio established in 2020 by designer Soichiro Tanaka (田中聡一朗, also known as So Tanaka), working across furniture, lighting and objects.

SOTANAKAは、デザイナー田中聡一朗が2020年に設立した東京を拠点とするデザインスタジオです。家具、照明、オブジェを手がけています。

Name: the studio is written SOTANAKA (one word, capitals). The designer is Soichiro Tanaka, who has also been credited in press as So Tanaka. Instagram: @s_o_tanaka. Not to be confused with other people named Soichiro Tanaka or So Tanaka.

Soichiro Tanaka studied at Musashino Art University, Department of Industrial, Interior and Craft Design (2016 to 2020).

## Pages

- [Bio](https://sotanaka.com/bio): about the studio, stockists, exhibitions, awards and press
- [Shop](https://sotanaka.com/shop): Furniture, lighting and objects by SOTANAKA, available to order.
- [Archive](https://sotanaka.com/archive): past exhibitions
- [Contact](https://sotanaka.com/contact): info@sotanaka.com, for exhibitions, commissions, production collaborations, wholesale enquiries or studio visits

## Works

- [Curly](https://sotanaka.com/curly) (2026): Curly is a table lamp by SOTANAKA, shaped by the curl paper keeps from being rolled for storage and transport.
- [Uneri](https://sotanaka.com/uneri) (2026): Uneri is a furniture collection by SOTANAKA, made from branches pruned from Tokyo's street trees and fallen wood gathered from local parks.
- [MO Lamp](https://sotanaka.com/mo-lamp) (2025): MO Lamp is a sculptural lighting work by SOTANAKA.
- [Let a Colored Paper Swim in the Clouds](https://sotanaka.com/let-a-colored-paper-swim-in-clouds) (2025): Let a Colored Paper Swim in the Clouds is a series of works in white cement and colored paper by SOTANAKA.
- [Liminal Lamp](https://sotanaka.com/liminal-lamp) (2025): Liminal Lamp is a lighting collection by SOTANAKA.
- [Liminal Objects](https://sotanaka.com/liminal-objects) (2025): Liminal Objects is a series of grid works in MDF and lacquer paint by SOTANAKA.
- [C ya](https://sotanaka.com/cya) (2025): C ya is a work by SOTANAKA exploring the curved mirror as a Japanese cultural object.
- [Memento](https://sotanaka.com/memento) (2023): Memento is a functional sculptural form in glazed porcelain by SOTANAKA.
- [Vnsh](https://sotanaka.com/vnsh) (2023): Vnsh is a lighting work in aluminium, stainless steel and MDF by SOTANAKA.
- [ORI](https://sotanaka.com/ori) (2019): Ori is a console in marble and MDF designed by SOTANAKA for Roche Bobois, Paris.
- [Less Than Instrument](https://sotanaka.com/lti) (2020): Less Than Instrument is a lighting collection in steel and copper by SOTANAKA.
- [Transfer](https://sotanaka.com/transfer) (2019): Transfer is a series of works in white cement and colored paper by SOTANAKA.

## Awards

- 2024: Kokuyo Design Award 2024 Merit and Audience Awards winner for Memento
- 2023: Designart Tokyo Under 30 winner for Vnsh
- 2021: Designart Tokyo Under 30 winner for Less Than Instrument (with Kentaro Takagi)
- 2021: Lexus Design Award shortlisted for Less Than Instrument
- 2020: Lexus Design Award shortlisted for PE Pottery
- 2019: Roche Bobois Award 2019 winner for ORI Console
